paragraphs.source_zh: 主人说：“就送三条干松鱼，太小气啦。”

paragraphs.source_en: Kangetsu said, “No, they gave me a great many; I brought three of them here.”

units.source_en: Kangetsu said, “No, they gave me a great many; I brought three of them here.”
units.source_zh: 寒月说：“不是，是送了很多的，我从中拿来三条。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 寒月说：“不是，是送了很多的，我从中拿来三条。”
